original_title: Colombian singer Yeison Jiménez among 6 dead after plane crash in central-eastern Colombia - ABC7 Los Angeles

ai_analysis.operational_impact: The crash may impact local aviation operations, with potential delays or cancellations of flights. The incident may also affect the transportation of cargo and personnel in the region.
